what: Planned interface contract for Compact SMG SM-01 (code SMG01): SK_SMG01 (rigged, held gun), SM_SMG01 (static twin, stock extended, magazine merged by default) and SM_SMG01_Mag (straight 25-round polymer magazine). Written by the game+tech planning role 2026-10-09 from the AR-01 pilot (RIFLE_BUILD_PLAN.md, RIFLE_REPORT.md section 10, gates/*.json, Scripts/guns/rifle/run_*.sh, gunlib). Companion: SMG_BUILD_PLAN.md.
status: PLAN. smg_spec.json (measurer + real-pattern study) overrides every value marked rough; names, bones, sockets, slots, budgets, gates and stage order here are the contract the spec fills.

panels: TOP (muzzle left; screen-down = +Y = the gun's left)
reference.ruler: unreliable (reads ~86 cm for 69); scale from the real pattern
reference.sheet_B: refused by the generator: unseen details stay plain

layout_rough_mm_from_muzzle_tip.note: ROUGH: LEFT panel silhouette scaled to 690 mm (~1.18 mm/px). The measurer's spec replaces every value. Heights relative to the rail top.

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: two moulded polymer shells (upper with the rail seat; lower with integral grip, guard and magwell); P-round 0.6-2 mm, 1-2 deg draft, a parting line on the mould split; ribs and the 2 x 2 side vents as geometry with wall thickness; flush pins as inset rings
separate steel rail from gunlib.rail_1913, true profile; length from the sheet, slot count = round(length / 10.01); butt joint 0.01-0.05 mm
short 1913 section under the front, same module
non-reciprocating, left front; knob + arm + internal slide pushing a lug on the bolt; rests forward, pulled -X, returns on its own spring; slot cut for the full travel
real_pattern_rulings.confirm: the sheet draws the open slot ahead of the knob: if the real pattern rests the handle at the slot's rear end, ask (design conflict)

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: blowback bolt block (face, extractor, firing-pin hole, charging lug) on guide rails; visible through the right port; travel = real figure (rough 60-70 mm, never less than a 32.4 mm round + feed clearance)
right side only, ~3 mm wall reveal, dark interior; barrel breech and the mag lips visible with the bolt back
ambidextrous: one transverse shaft with a lever each side, one part, one bone, rotate about Y; safe/semi/auto (+burst only if the real arc shows it); no markings; the sheet's red dots are not built
ambidextrous paddle behind the magwell, pivot about Y; its nose engages a notch on the mag's rear face
the real pattern has a left-side hold-open release; build it (bone bolt_catch) only if the sheet's LEFT view shows it; otherwise ReloadEmpty releases the bolt with the charging handle

side-folding skeleton polymer stock: two-knuckle hinge, vertical steel pin at the receiver rear, spring detent when extended, a hook/lip snapping over a receiver stud when folded; fold side and angle from the real pattern (the sheet's TOP view shows the knuckle toward the gun's right); the folded stock leaves the ejection throw path clear
serrated rear face as geometry; the stock frame's two round holes as through-holes

rail-clamp flip sights from one gunlib.sights_flip design (shared with CB01): clamp base with its recoil lug in a rail slot (integer index), spring-detented leaf on a transverse pin; rear diopter aperture (rough 2.0-2.6 mm, ghost-ring outer), front post in ears/hood; modelled UP with a folded state; no markings
integral polymer grip; stipple panel border in geometry, stipple in the normal map (roughness 0.75-0.90)
steel trigger blade (C-fillet); guard integral with the lower unless the sheet shows a seam
phosphated barrel, bore >= 2 calibres deep with a chamfered crown; slotted cage device with real through-slots on muzzle_device; muzzle_class '.45-class pistol calibre' as data only
straight double-stack polymer mag; the side ladder grooves and ribs as geometry; floor plate + tab; lips + follower modelled; no cartridge; catch notch on the rear face; no witness holes or numbers
flared well, two guide channels for the mag's guide ribs, a top shelf above the seated mag (overtravel), the catch window at the rear
the sheet's RIGHT panel mirrors the charging slot: the real pattern decides (plain wall if it has no right-side slot)
count and position from the sheet; sizes from norms under 4 sheet px; written in mm
none anywhere

sights.S2: B4 at LOD0-3 on the SK and the twin

handle back pushing the bolt, release, both forward

look.L1: blockout IoU sides >= 0.95, top >= 0.92; < 0.90 = stop and change the method
look.L2: form IoU: authority sides >= 0.96 (LEFT and RIGHT are both authority views: the labels are consistent), top >= 0.93; 3/4 FRONT (LEFT) camera-solved IoU >= 0.93 and P95 <= 3 px (exception only for proven 3/4-panel contradictions); per part IoU >= 0.95 (masks >= 400 px), thin parts P95 <= 1 px, max <= 2 px
look.L3: side contour P95 <= 2 sheet px; features <= 2 sheet px (vents, port, knob, selector hub, paddle, sights, hinge knuckle, stock openings + holes, buttpad serration ends, rail ends); angles <= 1 deg
look.L5: crop-matched hue, R/B, median luma within the stone S16 tolerances under the physical light
look.L7: blind design judge >= 12 pairs REPORTED (not blocking); 2 realism judges, 4 views + a folded-stock hero: <= 1 single-judge fake call
look.L8_early: form stage, per part group (receiver + rails, sights, grip + lower, stock + hinge, front end, magazine): 2 realism judges in the ROUGH LOOK with real photos beside; stop on a decisive fail

blender.B1: skeleton: root identity, 11 (12) names, parents body, rest identity, magazine unweighted survives the FBX
blender.B3: sweeps at LOD0-1: bolt, charging_handle (+ pusher-lug contact 0.0-0.05 mm, no penetration), trigger, selector (full arc, both levers), mag_release, stock 0..fold (step min(1 deg, 0.10 / r_max), or 0.25 deg steps each proving a min distance >= r_max x 0.25 deg / 2 outside the latch zone), sights 0..folded: 0 intersections, inside the 3.7 rows, only the declared allowances; LOD2-3 < 1 px at the switch distance
blender.B3b: folded stock clear of selector, knob, port, grip; the ShellEject throw cone (15 deg half-angle, 150 mm) clear of it
blender.B4: sockets on bones; Muzzle on the bore <= 0.5 mm / 0.05 deg; sight picture (sights block)
blender.B4c: folded sights under rail top + 12 mm
blender.B6: twin qa_check on the exported bytes: UCX keyed to the node, slot k on tile k, uv_no_overlap 0, no_coincident_vertices 0, UV1, LODs descending, budget 55000
blender.B6a: joined-twin qa_check topology + degenerate checks from form on
blender.B7: closed manifold; flat deviation < 1 deg; facet <= 7.5 deg at LOD0; bevels = spec +-0.05 mm and >= the visibility minimum
blender.B8: budgets; LOD-pop mean <= 1 px, max <= 3 px at each switch, both stock states
blender.B9: power of two, full mips; classes within +-15 % of target (P5..median); fill >= 70 / 65 %; metallic 0/1; dielectric BC sRGB 30-243 (below 50 only the declared black finishes); bare metal BC >= 186
blender.B10: tokenised gun deny list + qa_check deny list on names and shipped text; no text in maps
blender.B11: every LOD0-3 vertex at every clip frame and both stock states inside the bind AABB + bounds extension
blender.G5: 0 static intersections LOD0-1; butt gaps >= 0.01 mm; LOD2-3 < 1 px
blender.S1: exported sidecar sockets = build within 0.001 mm / 0.001 deg; counts = spec
blender.S2: B4 sight picture at LOD0-3 (SK and twin)
blender.H1_early: grip width/girth vs real polymer SMG grips; trigger reach; Grip depth within 1 mm of the fit body's palm; SupportHand on the magwell <= 1.5 mm; length of pull reported; cheek-weld eye height vs the sight line
blender.H1_full: study 7.2 H1 on MH_PlayerDefault: palm penetration <= 1 mm, trigger reach +-3 mm, IK residual < 0.5 mm, 0 intersections at rest and at clip extremes incl. stock folded and mag out; records hand_offset
blender.UD1: gunlib.tspace.unreal_drops(ob) = 0 on every part (after bl.finish) at LOD0-3, on the joined twin and on each SK LOD mesh; min triangle area >= 0.01 mm2
blender.UD2: 0 edges < 0.05 mm; 0 triangles with height < 0.02 mm over their longest edge; 0 bevel strips < 0.1 mm wide
blender.UD3: tspace.collapsed(me, 'UV0', unreal=True) = 0, float32_zero_corners = 0, edge_on_corners = 0 on every export mesh LOD0-3 (SK, twin, mag)
blender.UD4: authored UV1 inside 0..1, 0 overlap at 64 and 128 px with 2 px padding, every LOD

workflows.rule: each stage is a fresh workflow started from a named commit; holds lock SMG01 (+ GunLib while editing gunlib); one Blender process per step; never leaves a process running; writes WorkFiles/guns/smg/gates/<stage>.json (status, failed); ends with a commit; stops and shows the user on a decisive fail

order.name: plan + spec
order.does: measurement + traces, real-pattern study with photos, this plan; smg_spec.json; S0

order.name: form
order.does: W1a gunlib extraction (rail_1913, mag_box, hinge, sights_flip, hardware, gun_standard.json + standard.py, promoted gun-agnostic drivers; LIB_VERSION 0.2.0) with the AR-01 regression (gate values reproduced, export sha256 unchanged); W1b Scripts/guns/smg run_smg.sh: blockout (L1, B4) -> form (R1-R20, internals, both stock states, sights up and folded)

order.name: surface
order.does: UV by class + slot tiles, bakes (margin 0, mag AO alone), paint (same-side edge masks, analytic wear, polymer polish), Masks, Detail16 + recolour pre-check, renders from the baked maps

order.name: rig + mag
order.does: LOD1-3 (same generators), twin (hulls, sockets, tiles), LOD-pop on both stock states -> sizes on engine radii, S1/S2 at LOD0-3, G5 LOD2-3; rig, clips, bounds extension, export_skeletal_set + twin; fresh-process verify; SM_SMG01_Mag from the shipped twin bytes; M1-M10; H1 full; look check from the exported bytes

order.name: review + fix
order.does: review sets from the exported bytes under the physical light; L6, L7 (blind reported), 2 realism judges, tech review; FIX_LOG.md; fixes in the generators; full chain from nothing

order.name: Unreal
order.does: harness copied from WorkFiles/guns/rifle/UnrealCheck into WorkFiles/guns/smg/UnrealCheck; passes A, A2, B, C, D, E, F; /Game/GunCheck/SMG01_<run>; machine guard; sha256 at start and end

order.name: finish
order.does: pack materials under PackMaterials via run_build.sh from a short-path mirror root (items SMG01, SMG01_Static, SMG01_Mag, the recolour group, maps/derive_constants_smg01.py); READMEs; showcase/CompactSMG_SM01 via studio.py + the ASSET_LIST row (re-read first); release lock SMG01

workflows.run_chain: Scripts/guns/smg/run_smg.sh (stages 1-2) -> run_game.sh (3-4) -> run_rig_mag.sh (5-6), each resumable with --from; logs in WorkFiles/guns/smg/scratch/logs/
